title: Your Business
subtitle: Your products, prices, and business facts in one place — what Jawab relies on when it answers your customers.

readiness.title: What can Jawab answer about?
readiness.hint: Jawab answers instantly from what it knows. What's missing, your customers ask about and get nothing — tap to complete it.
readiness.productsChip: {count, plural, =0 {No products yet} one {# product} other {# products}}
readiness.allCovered: Jawab can answer all of these for your customers.

state.legendOptional: Optional — add it if you have one

products.title: Products & services
products.hint: Prices Jawab quotes to customers. Tap a price to edit it.
products.storeSynced: Your products sync automatically from your connected store.

facts.title: Business facts
facts.hint_phone: The number customers reach you on.
facts.hint_website: Your website, online store, or your Instagram/Facebook page link.
facts.hint_delivery: Delivery details — areas, cost, and how long it takes.
facts.hint_payment: The payment methods you accept, plus any conditions.
facts.placeholder_address: City, district, and a nearby landmark
facts.placeholder_delivery: Where you deliver, the cost, and how long it takes
facts.placeholder_payment: The methods you accept from customers
facts.hoursPickDay: Pick at least one working day.
facts.hoursOverlap: These periods overlap — adjust the times
facts.deliveryAreasPlaceholder: e.g. all city districts, or specific areas
facts.deliveryCostPlaceholder: e.g. a flat fee, or varies by area
facts.paymentNotePlaceholder: e.g. a local wallet app, or a deposit up front
facts.freeTextInstead: Write it as free text instead
facts.presetNoWebsite: We do not have a website
facts.storeAnsweredHint: Your connected store already answers this. Write here only if you want a custom answer.

info.title: Additional information
info.hint: For anything the fields above don't cover: FAQs, special details, whatever else Jawab should know.

noPage: Connect a page to set up your business information.
noConnectedPageHint: You have pages that lost their connection and need reconnecting. Reconnect them to manage their business info here.

lists.title: Business lists
lists.rowDateHint: Jawab stops mentioning a dated row the day after its start date. The end date is for display only.
lists.expiredToggle: {count, plural, one {# expired row} other {# expired rows}}
lists.completenessAsk: Is this list complete — nothing else exists?
lists.completenessConfirmed: Marked complete: the assistant answers a confident “not available” for anything not listed.
lists.completenessPartial: Marked partial: the assistant says “not registered in my list” and offers direct contact.
lists.loadFailed: Could not load your lists. Check your connection and try again.
lists.errStaleRow: This row changed elsewhere — reloading the list.
lists.errRowLimit: This list is full ({max} rows). Delete a row before adding another.
lists.errLastRow: A list needs at least one row. Delete the whole list instead.
lists.errDateOrder: The end date cannot be before the start date.
lists.groupedHint: Everything about one item in one card — its prices and its dates together. Jawab quotes these exactly; a dated row hides itself automatically once its date passes.
lists.fieldLabelTaken: This field name is already used
lists.dateRangeInvalid: The end date must not be before the start date
lists.deleteEntity: Delete this item and its dates
lists.timeCurrentText: Current text: “{text}” — pick both times to replace it
lists.announcedCount: {count, plural, one {# announced date} other {# announced dates}}
lists.autofilledHint: Read automatically from the text — review, then save
lists.upcomingCount: {count, plural, one {# upcoming date} other {# upcoming dates}}
lists.completenessHint: This controls how Jawab answers when a customer asks about something that is not in this list.
lists.searchPlaceholder: Search this list — by name or area…
lists.searchAllPlaceholder: Search your lists — by name or details…
lists.searchCount: Showing {shown, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} of {total}
lists.searchCountCards: Showing {shown, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of {total}
